$comment: CrewAI's A2A delegation: `Agent(a2a=A2AClientConfig(endpoint=url))` (the deprecated `A2AConfig` alike) resolves the remote agent's card at that URL (its own `.../.well-known/agent-card.json` or the agent's base URL), then sends it messages when the agent delegates: both are reported at the configuration. `A2AServerConfig` describes the agent CrewAI serves and is no call.
